name: AcSplitFormOrientation
description: Used with the SplitFormOrientation property to specify the orientation of the datasheet in relation to the form while in Split Form view.

constants.name: acDatasheetOnTop
constants.description: The datasheet is displayed above the form.

constants.name: acDatasheetOnBottom
constants.description: The datasheet is displayed below the form.

constants.name: acDatasheetOnLeft
constants.description: The datasheet is displayed to the left of the form.

constants.name: acDatasheetOnRight
constants.description: The datasheet is displayed to the right of the form.
